scope: Post-open mechanism attribution on the already opened BLASTNet Case 5 trajectory. It tests whether the actual 42-frame density trajectory aligns with weak directions of the fixed v210 low-64 response Gram. It is not a predictor, reconstruction method, fresh external gate, resource result, curved-ray result, or real-BOST result.
scientific_question: Does source alignment, rather than a source-blind spectral floor, strictly separate every passing virtual-ring nine-camera rig from every failing supplied nine-camera calibration?

opened_truth.preprocessing: Reuse the frozen v207 finite-only rectilinear interpolation to 32x16x16, zero outer boundary, supported-interior zero-mean gauge, with no clipping or shifting.
opened_truth.role: Truth is used only for this post-open mechanism attribution. It is forbidden from any deployment input, threshold fit, fallback, or future predictor feature.

supplied_nine_failing.reference_outcome: 0/546 strict cells and 0/13 complete calibration groups at zero-start CGLS K16 in v208.

virtual_ring_nine_passing.reference_outcome: 546/546 strict cells and 13/13 complete rig groups at zero-start CGLS K16 in v209.

virtual_ring_twelve_diagnostic.role: diagnostic only; it cannot replace the virtual-nine family

fixed_subspace.inheritance: Exactly the v210 fixed low-64 sine span, support, gauge, rank, orthonormalization invariants, reported geometry, and exact forward response.

unique_primary.name: worst_frame_source_weighted_harmonic_observability
unique_primary.geometry_gram: For response M, G=M^T M/observation_scalar_count and G_normalized=64*G/trace(G), exactly as in v210.
unique_primary.source_coefficients: For each preprocessed density x_t and an orthonormal basis B of the fixed low-64 span, c_t=B*x_t.
unique_primary.frame_metric: If G_normalized=V diag(lambda) V^T, h_t=||c_t||^2 / sum_i((v_i^T c_t)^2/max(lambda_i,64*float64_epsilon)). Larger is better. Any eigenvalue below -1e-10 times the largest invalidates execution; roundoff-negative values are clipped to zero only after that check.
unique_primary.geometry_metric: minimum h_t over all 42 opened frames; the minimum is fixed because the parent reference claim is complete-trajectory adequacy.
unique_primary.strict_separation_gate: min(primary over all 13 virtual-ring nine-camera rigs) must be strictly greater than max(primary over all 13 supplied nine-camera calibrations).
unique_primary.pairwise_audit: Report all 169 virtual-nine versus supplied-nine comparisons; exact ties are not passes.

frozen_controls_and_diagnostics.source_blind_parent_control: Recompute the v210 trace-normalized low-64 Gram spectral floor and its 169 pair comparisons. It cannot replace the unique primary.
frozen_controls_and_diagnostics.source_weighted_rayleigh_observability: For each frame report c_t^T G_normalized c_t / ||c_t||^2 and its per-geometry minimum; diagnostic only.
frozen_controls_and_diagnostics.low64_source_energy_fraction: Report ||c_t||^2/||x_t||^2 for all 42 frames; diagnostic only and not a fitted validity threshold.
frozen_controls_and_diagnostics.virtual_twelve: Diagnostic only; cannot upgrade a failed virtual-nine primary.

execution_contract.camera_permutation_rule: Reversing camera blocks may only permute response rows; all source-weighted and source-blind metrics must agree within 1e-12.

independent_validation.implementation: A second program must independently parse all 42 raw density files and three grids, reproduce interpolation and gauge without importing the formal preprocessing or v213 runner, build the same low-64 span with SVD rather than QR, independently reconstruct supplied and virtual geometry, recompute every Gram, source coefficient, frame metric, geometry metric, family summary, pairwise decision, and input seal.

decision_order: Any parent mismatch, source/input drift, prohibited scientific-array read, non-finite value, rank loss, invalid eigenvalue, camera-permutation failure, missing frame/geometry, formal-independent mismatch, or output mutation gives INCONCLUSIVE_INVALID_SOURCE_WEIGHTED_OBSERVABILITY_EXECUTION_V213.

If all 169 virtual-nine versus supplied-nine primary comparisons are strictly greater, conclude PASS_ACTUAL_SOURCE_ALIGNMENT_STRICTLY_SEPARATES_CASE5_REFERENCE_V213. This is opened-data mechanism evidence only.
Otherwise conclude FAIL_ACTUAL_SOURCE_ALIGNMENT_DOES_NOT_RESOLVE_CASE5_REFERENCE_OVERLAP_V213 and close this fixed-low64 actual-source-alignment explanation.
Controls, diagnostics, virtual-twelve results, near misses, medians, or post-hoc thresholds may never replace or upgrade the unique primary.
